caveats: Current prices mean nominal amounts; the 2015 national-accounts base does not make these inflation-adjusted values or a 2015=100 index. Parentheses denote negative external balances and shares. Consumption and capital totals overlap their subcomponents, while the external balance already subtracts imports from exports; summing every row double-counts GDP. Small differences between displayed component sums and totals are retained as published rounding. The table is national and cannot establish district output, real growth or household welfare.
Accounting parentheses are parsed as negative numbers and retained in reported_token. All figures remain on their printed nominal or percentage scale.
grain: One national expenditure-side GDP component and measure per year
notes: DCS expenditure-side national accounts for 2021–2025, at current prices within the 2015-base national-accounts framework. Thirteen reported items include consumption and its components, gross capital formation and its components, exports, imports, the external balance and GDP at market prices. Each has a nominal value in LKR million and a published percentage of GDP. The source marks 2023–2024 revised and 2025 provisional.
